publishers.updatePolicy: Used by the RxNav drug identity source, which runs only when OPENPLANS_RXNAV_IDENTITY=on. One lookup per drug question whose RxCUI is not in an ACTIVE local RxNorm release: properties first, then history status for an RxCUI without current properties. No enumeration or pre-warming. Answers stay in memory for 24 hours (1 hour when not confirmed) and are never stored. Robots answers a direct 404 (no rules); the egress country is recorded without restricting use. The terms page on www.lhncbc.nlm.nih.gov is read and its hash checked before the first call and daily after that, and a changed page stops calls. Paced at 5 s, far under the published 20 requests per second.

terms.basis: RxNav Terms of Service: "The APIs (RxNorm, RxTerms, Prescribable RxNorm, and RxClass) may be used free-of-charge." "NLM requires that users of the APIs ... send no more than 20 requests per second per IP address." "NLM recommends caching results for a 12-24 hour period." "RxNav and the RxNorm API provide non-proprietary content from RxNorm". Applications that use NLM data include NLM's statement, which the evidence block carries.
